Verification (post-batch, 33 fresh-context reads; full log in batches/2026-10-17-2257/VERIFICATION.md): VERDICT CHANGED, Rejected to Provisional, on a late Gate 4 that ran separately and cold.
- Why it was re-run: two of three batch adversaries returned Provisional with Disguise Resolved; the third returned Rejected with Disguise and Presupposition failure Unresolved, and both of those grounds had two legs, of which verification broke one each.
- Wang, Lindsay et al. 2005 estimates unobserved GENES, not isoforms. Its real title is "Gene capture prediction and overlap estimation in EST sequencing from one or multiple libraries"; the zero class is the number of genes with no EST in the library; the "35%-40%" bias and the 12030-vs-9155 and 12085-vs-9492 figures are estimates of GENE number; and the "ISO" in "ISO error correction" is insufficient overlap, a clustering error, not isoform. Two readers disagree on one point and the disagreement is recorded rather than resolved: the fuller read (BMC HTML plus Springer PDF) found splicing treated as a bias source inflating gene counts and quotes a sentence to that effect, while a second partial read found splicing not treated at all. The fuller read is preferred.
- Houseley & Tollervey 2010 does not support the donor leg of attack 4. Every quoted phrase is in it, but reproducibility was tested only across repeated RT reactions, enzymes, temperatures and priming on the SAME in vitro purified substrates, never across independent RNA preparations, donors or individuals, and no template-switching rate is quantified. Adversary 3 had labelled that extension as its own inference; it is unsourced, so under the ENVIRONMENT rule the ground is Partial at best and never Unresolved.
- Melamud & Moult 2009 (two readers) is an error-rate and observed-count noise model with simulated EST sampling, estimating per-gene error rates of 1-10%; in the parts both could open it estimates no count of unobserved isoform classes and names no richness estimator. One reader did not reach the Discussion, so that absence is over the parts read. Pickrell et al. 2010, read in full, carries every quoted phrase and figure, uses no richness or capture-recapture estimator, does not discuss RT artefacts, and its depth analysis is GRAPHICAL ONLY with no model fitted and no extrapolation — so it poses the direction, not the asymptote.
- A citation error in the attack, flagged inline: Chiu & Chao 2016 (PeerJ 4:e1634) was cited under the title "Species richness estimation with high diversity but spurious singletons", which belongs to Willis, arXiv:1604.02598. Both papers are real. Chiu & Chao's actual title is "Estimating and comparing microbial diversity in the presence of sequencing errors"; it replaces the observed singleton count with a nonparametric estimate from f2-f4 and feeds an adjusted Chao1, its worked data are viral metagenome contig spectra, and transcripts, isoforms, RNA-seq and cDNA do not appear in it.
- The record's own two nearest priors hold. bioRxiv 10.1101/2025.07.02.662769 is Schertzer, Park, Su, Reese, Sheynkman & Knowles, "Perplexity as a Metric for Isoform Diversity in the Human Transcriptome", 124 ENCODE4 PacBio datasets, per-gene D0 and D1 (Hill q=1), with no Chao1, Good-Turing or extrapolation. Genome Research 35(4):583 is a Perspective by Monzo, Frankish & Conesa: conceptual, no estimate of undiscovered isoforms, qualitative on depth.
- Late Gate 4 form, disclosed: the enumerated eight-attack adversary brief is unusable in this environment, so the gaps were asked as four neutral literature questions, one agent each, and two cold judges were handed the Gate 0-3 record, the established facts above, every answer, and the prior grade declared void. Both returned PROVISIONAL independently with NO Unresolved attack, so the fatal rule is not triggered. Judge 1: Resolved on Triviality and Combinatorial novelty, Partial on the other six. Judge 2: Resolved on Triviality, Combinatorial novelty, Vagueness and Dissolution, Partial on Disguise, Presupposition failure, Significance inflation and Reason for silence. Neither found a key kill; judge 2 recorded "None". Logs: UQ-20261017-53-late-judge-1.md and -2.md.
- A defect in the judges' brief, disclosed: it quoted the record's Well-posedness 3/3 rather than this entry's Gate 5 regrade to 2/3. The error could only have made the judges more lenient, and they still returned Provisional with both fatal attacks Partial, so the outcome does not turn on it. The regrade to 2/3 stands on its other limbs and bars Validated independently, but its first limb rested on the same unsourced donor-reproducibility inference and is withdrawn.
- Validated is barred by Well-posedness 2/3 and by an incomplete search record (the two summariser-only neighbours named under Novelty confidence), not by any surviving fatal objection.

ID: UQ-20261017-54
Date: 2026-10-17
Status: Provisional
Domain(s): Biology — structural cell biology (in-cell cryo-electron tomography); quantitative systems biology. Neighbour vocabularies swept: biophysics (crowding/quinary), pharmacology (PET occupancy, free-drug/Kpuu), in-cell NMR, SMLM, metabolomics/in vivo enzymology, bioinorganic chemistry, cryo-EM population estimation.

Question (canonical) — V2 after the one permitted Gate 1 reformulation: For macromolecular complexes whose ligand- or nucleotide-bound states are resolvable and countable in situ by cryo-electron tomography, and whose state is a reversible binding equilibrium on the timescale of the measurement (driven cycles admitted only with a declared steady-state rather than equilibrium null), does the measured in-cell occupancy of each bound state match the occupancy predicted from in vitro dissociation constants and the measured or bounded intracellular FREE ligand concentration, and what is the sign and magnitude of the signed log-ratio discrepancy across complexes?

Alternative formulations:
- Do in-cell structural state censuses agree with occupancies predicted from in vitro dissociation constants and cellular free-ligand concentrations?
- How wrong is the biochemical prediction of binding-state occupancy inside a living cell, when occupancy is counted structurally rather than inferred from an assay?
(V1 as intaked, and the reason for the reformulation — V1 rested feasibility on a GTP-consuming elongation cycle while excluding driven cycles — in batches/2026-10-17-2257/UQ-20261017-54-record.md.)

Motivating gap:
Subtomogram classification has made "fraction of complex X in state S inside an intact cell" a directly counted quantity (Xue et al.: 101,696 ribosomes, 356 tomograms; elongation classes 70% of localized ribosomes; 72%/67.5%/59.5% trapped under three drugs; polysomes 26.2%). Cell-scale kinetic models are parameterised from in vitro Kd on a single free pool. The record found no source using an in-situ census as a quantitative test of that transfer; the three terms the test needs (free ligand, classification error, vitrification fidelity) are each named in the literature and none assembled.

Presuppositions (8; full list in the record):
1. In-situ classification yields state fractions with a quantifiable error rate — CONTESTED (Evans et al. 2025: class-count populations "should not be used as quantitative evidence of the thermodynamics"; Xue et al. report no misclassification rate).
2. Intracellular FREE ligand measurable or boundable in the same cells — CONTESTED and binding (Xue et al.: "the exact concentrations of antibiotics inside cells cannot be determined").
3. Vitrification preserves the state distribution — CONTESTED, partly argued.
4. In vitro Kd exists for the same complex and ligand — established only case-by-case; adversary #1 verified that of the record's own three ligand cases only chloramphenicol supplies a Kd (Spt has a saturating concentration only; the "puromycin-like" IC50 is pseudouridimycin's, an RNA-polymerase number — two material corrections to the record).
5. The declared null is the appropriate reference — declared AS the object of test.
6-7. Counting statistics and physiological-state reproducibility — FLAGGED.
8. Driven cycles out of scope absent a declared steady-state null — SCOPE RESTRICTION, now in the canonical wording.

What would count as an answer:
For >= 3 complexes each with (a) an in-situ census with counting statistics, (b) an in vitro Kd under stated conditions, (c) a measured or bounded intracellular free-ligand concentration: a table of signed log(observed/predicted) occupancy with propagated uncertainty; a test of shared sign and magnitude versus complex-specificity; an error budget separating classification, free-concentration and affinity-transfer error.

48 distinct queries total: 11 at Gate 2 (record), plus 9 each from three independent adversaries in vocabularies Gate 2 did not try (full lists and access notes in batches/2026-10-17-2257/UQ-20261017-54-record.md and -adversary-1/-2/-3.md). Most informative:

COULD NOT READ (PMC barred, doi.org 403) — corroborating only, grounds no grade.

PNAS 2017 FETCH FAILED, so Unverified, grounds no grade.

Mandatory "fraction of X already published" check: YES for ribosomes (per-state fractions above), confirmed verbatim from the P1 preprint by adversary #1.

Novelty — nearest prior formulations (3, with sources):
P1'. Metalation calculators for E. coli JM109(DE3), bioRxiv 2022.05.06.490408 — OPENED (adv #3). Unit: individual metalloproteins in a bacterial cell. Endpoint: predicted fractional metal occupancy per protein ("Metal affinities ... entered as dissociation constants"; availabilities from metal-sensor responses). Comparator: reported in-cell metalation, case by case (SodA predicted 3.4% Fe aerobically vs reported mis-metalation). Estimand: in-cell fractional occupancy from in vitro Kd x measured intracellular available concentration. All three of the candidate's terms, assembled, across many proteins, as a published tool.
P2'. "Determination of intracellular protein-ligand binding affinity by competition binding in-cell NMR", Acta Cryst D 2021, journals.iucr.org/d/issues/2021/10/00/qt5006/qt5006.pdf — OPENED (adv #3). Unit: carbonic anhydrase II plus seven/four inhibitors in human cells. Endpoint: intracellular Kd computed from "fractions of CA II bound to each ligand" — an occupancy readout. Comparator: the in vitro Kd for the same pairs, numerically (MZA 37 nM both; SLC 79+/-3 vs 95+/-8 and 111+/-11; AAZ 15 vs 18+/-1; ETZ 0.45+/-0.02 vs 1.6+/-0.3 and 3.7+/-0.6). Estimand: in-cell versus in vitro affinity for the same complex and ligand, with the authors' stated verdict on the sign/magnitude limb. Free ligand is held known/constant rather than inferred.
P3'. Xue et al., "Visualizing translation dynamics at atomic detail inside a bacterial cell", bioRxiv 2021.12.18.473270 (Nature 2022) — OPENED (record; quotations re-verified verbatim by adv #1; published version COULD NOT READ — nature.com, doi.org, bork.embl.de all refused). Unit: individual 70S subtomograms in intact cells. Endpoint: fraction per elongation state. Comparator: condition contrasts plus qualitative concordance with single-molecule work; no mass-action calculation. Estimand: in-cell relative state abundance read as a "putative energy landscape".
Further neighbours, named and not grounding the grade because unread: Bennett et al. 2009 (implied active-site occupancy), DMPK free-drug/Kpuu and Mateus 2017 PNAS, PET in vivo affinity, Asano et al. proteasome census. Evans et al. 2025 (bioRxiv 2025.03.27.644168, OPENED by record and adv #1) is a methods prior on presupposition 1 only.

Novelty — how this differs from each:
vs P1': same three-term assembly and the same predicted estimand, different instrument and object class — metal sensors and metalation assays rather than subtomogram counting, metalloproteins rather than cryo-ET-resolvable complexes. P1' reports no measured occupancy for its best case and propagates uncertainty only into availability, not occupancy; the candidate adds a measured-occupancy term, propagated uncertainty and a cross-complex shared-sign test. That is a readout swap plus an uncertainty upgrade on a question already posed, tooled and published.
vs P2': the comparison the candidate proposes is performed here for a reversible, non-driven complex-ligand equilibrium in living human cells, with in-cell bound fractions on one side and in vitro Kd on the other, and the discrepancies are reported with uncertainties. What differs is the readout (NMR-resolved bound fraction, not a structural class count), the handling of free ligand (held constant rather than measured in situ), and the absence of a separated three-term error budget. The question, not merely the quantity, is the same one.
vs P3': same modality and counted quantity, different comparator; and P3' is a driven cycle, which V2 admits only under a steady-state null, so it is not even a single-complex instance of the candidate's equilibrium branch.

Novelty confidence: Medium
(Downgraded from the record's Medium to Low at Gate 5, then RESTORED to Medium on verification, which opened both precedents the downgrade rested on and found that neither performs the move attributed to it. P1' only PREDICTS: it combines in vitro dissociation constants with intracellular available metal concentrations to predict fractional occupancy and discusses agreement with the literature case by case, reporting no independently measured in-cell protein occupancy anywhere — so it supplies two of the candidate's three terms and never the third, which is the one the candidate's question is about. P2' measures an occupancy but lacks the free-ligand term and the cross-complex comparison: one protein (carbonic anhydrase II) with four sulfonamide ligands in HEK 293T cells, every Table 3 affinity figure real and in nM, the MZA in-cell value not an independent measurement, intracellular free ligand held known by design rather than measured in situ, and its conclusion that in-cell Kd is similar to in vitro. 48 queries, so not Unverified. Medium rather than High because both remain genuinely close neighbours — P2' poses the in-cell-versus-in-vitro affinity question for a reversible complex and answers it numerically — and because the absence sweep for a cryo-ET state census compared against a mass-action prediction is thin. Medium with close neighbours is Gate 5's Provisional case outright.)

Significance — consequence:
Real but modest, and it is not the failing gate. Inside the error budget: the commonest parameter-transfer move in cell-scale modelling is vindicated structurally. Shared sign: a correction factor with an uncertainty, and in-cell occupancy becomes a calibration target. Complex-specific: no transferable correction.
Significance — audience:
(i) whole-cell/cell-scale kinetic modellers; (ii) in-cell structural biologists producing censuses; (iii) cryo-EM population-estimation methodologists; (iv) in-cell biophysics (crowding/quinary); (v) target-engagement pharmacology. Audience (ii)-(iii) is the one with an evidenced unmet ask: of the three in-cell censuses opened across the record and adversaries, none reports a classification error rate, one reports no per-state counts at all, and all convert populations into qualitative narrative.
Significance — fecundity:
Does the offset scale with size, charge or local crowding; is in-situ classification a Boltzmann-faithful estimator; can free ligand be inferred FROM occupancy; does the offset differ by compartment or growth state; minimum particle count for a decision-grade interval.
Significance — anchoring:
Crowding/quinary affinity shifts; population estimation from class counts (Evans et al. 2025); free-versus-total concentration in metabolomics and in-cell NMR; parameter provenance in whole-cell models.

Reason for silence:
Claimed: disciplinary boundary on top of a new instrument, plus an incentive gap (a null has no home as a structure paper). Judged: substantially defeated. Adversary #3's bioinorganic precedent shows the asking requires no new instrument and is rewarded when done; adversary #1 found that the residual silence reduces largely to the measurement being uninformative where it is feasible, i.e. "answering is hard", which the pipeline refuses as a mechanism; the incentive limb is unevidenced. Per Gate 4 attack 7, a mechanism that fails this way makes the novelty finding itself suspect and returns the candidate to Gate 2 — which is where it was decided.

Nothing Unresolved from any adversary. Unverified sub-checks inside attack 2 (two adversaries) independently bar Validated; the Disguise sweeps themselves were executed (9 new-vocabulary queries each), so Disguise is not wholly unverified and the rejection rests only on sources actually opened (P1', P2', Simoncelli, the two ATP-synthase censuses), never on the unread items.

Scores: Well-posedness 2/3 · Significance 2/3
Well-posedness 2/3 (the record's own grade, upheld and reinforced): the equilibrium branch has no demonstrated instance; for the admitted driven branch the declared predictor cannot build the declared null; the free-ligand term is declared undeterminable in the best census; and classification error enters as a model-dependent bias rather than a scalar rate, so the promised three-term budget may not be constructible. Independently below the 3/3 Validated threshold.

Strongest remaining objection:
Independent of the Gate 2 ground, and sourced to P3's own verified text: the candidate's informative regime and its measurable regime do not overlap in any demonstrated instance. The one ample census dosed its ligands "much higher than the reported saturating concentrations", where theta = [L]/(Kd+[L]) -> 1 and the prediction stops depending on the affinity, so the computable log-ratios test classification fidelity rather than affinity transfer; the regime that would test affinity transfer is the one where the same paper says "the exact concentrations of antibiotics inside cells cannot be determined". This entry wrote that the objection means withdrawing the disguised-known ground "would not rehabilitate this entry", and that sentence is retracted: it conflates not reaching Validated with staying Rejected. No adversary graded any attack Unresolved, so under Gate 5 an unresolved non-fatal objection of exactly this kind caps the entry at Provisional rather than rejecting it, and with Gate 2's ground withdrawn no gate fails. The objection keeps all its force in its proper place, as the cap and the promotion condition below.

Promotion requires: all three of — (1) one demonstrated instance where the informative and measurable regimes overlap, that is a complex with a classification-resolved in-situ state census, an in vitro Kd for that complex and ligand, and a free intracellular concentration bounded tightly enough that predicted occupancy is not pinned at 0 or 1 — this is the objection above and it is what would move well-posedness from 2/3 to 3/3; (2) the absence limb swept to the ground, which at minimum means opening Xue et al. 2022 (Nature; bioRxiv 2021.12.18.473270) at a working route and at least one visual-proteomics or in-situ structural review, since two sweeps returned NOT FOUND having between them opened only two papers on searches that gave titles without snippets; (3) a stated argument that the signed cross-complex test is identifiable once classification error enters as a model-dependent bias rather than a scalar rate, which the record itself flags as the reason the promised three-term error budget may not separate.

Suggested first step toward an answer (pointer only — not taken):
Before any occupancy is computed, enumerate from EMPIAR/EMDB in-cell tomography depositions every complex with a classification-resolved state census and per-class particle counts, and score each against (b) an in vitro Kd for that complex and ligand and (c) a free intracellular concentration bounded tightly enough that predicted occupancy is not pinned at 0 or 1 — and, before that, open P1' and P2' and the free-drug/Kpuu line to establish what the swapped-instrument version would add that those do not already deliver.

Routing (if rejected as already-asked):
Not applicable — no longer rejected. The entry is Provisional, so the ledger is still claiming its question as un-asked and the question is not routed. Nothing adjacent is routed either: the narrower question that does remain open (whether in-situ class counts are a thermodynamically faithful population estimator) is already an active named problem owned by cryo-EM methodology (Evans et al. 2025), so it has an owner rather than needing one.


Verification (post-batch, 33 fresh-context reads; full log in batches/2026-10-17-2257/VERIFICATION.md): VERDICT CHANGED, Rejected to Provisional. No late Gate 4 was needed, and here is why.
- Gate 4 ran properly in the batch: three adversaries, none of which graded any attack Unresolved, all three returning Provisional. What fell on verification was not an adversary's ground but the Gate 5 judge's own Gate 2 downgrade from Medium to Low. The late-Gate-4 rule exists for a candidate whose Gate 4 is incomplete or whose fatal adversarial ground is withdrawn; neither applies, so re-running eight attacks would add nothing the three existing logs do not already carry. The entry says this so a reader can check the call.
- P1' (metalation calculators, bioRxiv 2022.05.06.490408) only PREDICTS. It combines in vitro dissociation constants with intracellular available metal concentrations to predict fractional occupancy, and discusses agreement with the literature case by case. It reports NO independently measured in-cell protein occupancy. A prior that predicts a quantity without ever measuring it is not a disguised known for a question about the gap between prediction and measurement.
- P2' (in-cell NMR competition binding, Acta Cryst D 2021) is real and was opened as a PDF. One protein, carbonic anhydrase II, with four sulfonamide ligands in HEK 293T cells. Every quoted affinity figure exists in Table 3 and is in nM. Two qualifications matter: the MZA in-cell value is not an independent measurement, and intracellular free ligand is HELD KNOWN BY DESIGN rather than measured in situ, so the paper assembles two of the candidate's three terms and not the third. Its stated conclusion is that in-cell Kd is similar to in vitro.
- With both grounds narrowed, novelty returns to Medium with close neighbours, which Gate 5 names as the Provisional case outright, and Well-posedness 2/3 bars Validated independently. The verdict is Provisional, not Validated, and the regime-overlap objection above is the cap.
- The absence limb is weak and is recorded as weak, never as a check that passed. Two sweeps for a cryo-ET or in-situ state census compared against a mass-action prediction both returned NOT FOUND, but between them they opened only two papers and their searches returned titles without snippets; Xue et al. 2022 (Nature) and the candidate visual-proteomics reviews are COULD NOT READ. Two in-cell ribosome studies were confirmed to publish state fractions (proportions of classified particles, with the denominator shifting between all 80S, translating ribosomes and free 60S) and to make no thermodynamic comparison.

---
ID: UQ-20261017-55
Date: 2026-10-17
Status: Provisional
Domain(s): Biology — cell-culture methodology and in vitro model fidelity (non-clinical basic biology). Adjacent: comparative thermal physiology; measurement-condition specification and standards (GCCP 2.0, ALTEX, PRINCE); metascience of model-system external validity.

Question (canonical): For K >= 3 cell types pre-declared from tissues whose in vivo temperature is distinctly non-37 °C (at least one cooler and one warmer), in a 2x2 factorial crossing tissue-matched vs 37 °C temperature with physioxic vs atmospheric oxygen, with proliferation-rate-matched controls and a distance metric to a freshly isolated in vivo reference profile both declared before any data are taken: what fraction of the baseline in vitro-to-in vivo distance is closed by temperature correction, reported per cell type with confidence intervals alongside the fraction closed by oxygen correction measured on the same scale and in the same experiment, and the temperature x oxygen interaction?

Alternative formulations:
- V1, as received at intake (one Gate 1 reformulation was used; V2 above is the graded version): for cell types native to tissues whose in vivo temperature differs materially from 37 °C, how much of the phenotypic discordance between cultured cells and their in vivo counterparts is attributable to the universal 37 °C culture default? Reformulated because "how much is attributable" named no estimand, reference or metric; no change of subject matter.
- Is the standard 37 °C incubator a mis-specified condition for cells from cooler and warmer tissues, and how far do their transcriptomes, proliferation and differentiation move toward in vivo profiles at tissue-matched temperature?
- Does cell culture have a temperature problem of the same size as its documented oxygen problem?

Motivating gap: Silence mapping, not an anomaly. The oxygen default carries a named mis-specification critique (physioxia; Alva et al. 2022 calls the commonly cited 20-21% O2 figures "incorrect"), while the temperature default is dense in how-answers (incubator specification, calibration, QC logging) and near-empty of why-questions, though in vivo tissue temperature spans roughly 32-40 °C. Verified from sources opened: Klein et al. 2022 gives tissue-matched O2 values (13% lung, 1-3% uterus) and no tissue-matched temperature values, writing "It is implicitly assumed that culture temperature is controlled at 37°C" and that thermal regimes "may be reliably inferred from calibrated incubators" (quotes independently re-verified verbatim by adversaries 1 and 3); GCCP 2.0 files temperature under calibration/monitoring/records with thresholds framed as heat shock >39 °C and slowed replication <35 °C, and calls room air "hyperoxic, hypocapnic, and cold for cells in culture", taking 37 °C as the zero point.

Presuppositions:
1. Source-tissue in vivo temperature known to ~1 °C in the relevant state — CONTESTED for deep organs and across diurnal/activity variation; partially supported for the reproductive tract (Grinsted 1985; Bahat 2003/Hunter 1986, via Cochrane CD012192).
2. 37 °C is the near-universal default — UNVERIFIED as a number and now CONTRAINDICATED: no protocol-corpus survey exists (record query 9; adversary queries 1/8), and the only corpus datum in play, from the record's own load-bearing source, points softer — Klein et al. 2022: "42% reported temperature and CO2 incubator settings" and "a number of studies used different culture temperatures". Applied subfields have already moved off it (broiler SC standard is 38 °C; Hanwoo SC tested at 39 °C).
3. Cultured cells retain temperature-responsive programmes — SUPPORTED (Metzger et al. 2022, genome-wide transcript and bioenergetic responses at 35/39/41 vs 37 °C).
4. An in vivo reference profile exists against which discordance is measurable — LOAD-BEARING, weakest link, and now damaged: van den Brink et al. 2017 (Nat Methods 14:935-936, opened by adversary 3) documents the reference-side artefact as an HSP/IEG signature ("Fos expression is induced during the SC isolation procedure"; "Hspa1b is also higher expressed in 2-hour collagenase-treated than in 1-hour") whose validated fixes are selections on a stress phenotype (MitoTracker-high, FSC-H gating).
5. Temperature effects separable from the proliferation-rate change temperature causes — MAJOR CONFOUNDER; V2 requires rate-matched controls (GCCP 2.0: "growth below 35°C typically slows replication").
6. Incubators hold alternative setpoints without altering pH or dissolved gas — FEASIBILITY, contested: CO2/bicarbonate pH equilibrium is temperature-dependent, so pH must be instrumented, not assumed.
7. "Discordance attributable to temperature" is estimable as a distance reduction under a pre-declared metric — accepted only as a convention.
8. Media formulated at 37 °C do not become limiting at other temperatures — CONFOUNDER, unchecked; physiological-media x oxygen factorials already exist, so media is a live third factor.

What would count as an answer: Per cell type, the fraction of baseline in vitro-to-in vivo distance closed by tissue-matched temperature with CIs, reported beside the fraction closed by physioxia on the same scale in the same experiment, plus the interaction. A negligible temperature share beside a large oxygen share retires the question. A comparable or larger share, or a strong interaction, makes culture temperature a per-cell-type specification the standards and reporting-checklist community would have to justify rather than inherit. Genuine asymmetry: the oxygen side of that comparison does not exist either — Alva et al. 2022 is narrative with no pooled effect size or attribution estimate, and three independent answer-side sweeps (record query 6; adversary 1 query 7; adversary 2 query 4; adversary 3 query 1) found no variance share or distance-closed fraction for temperature or oxygen — so the scale would have to be built by the same experiment.

Novelty — queries run (query -> one-line result): 39 distinct queries. Gate 2 ran 12 (cap 11; overrun declared, not hidden) — full list and one-line results in batches/2026-10-17-2257/UQ-20261017-55-record.md. Gate 4 added 27 in vocabularies Gate 2 did not try (9 per adversary, caps met, none refused) — full lists in UQ-20261017-55-adversary-1.md, -2.md, -3.md. Most informative:
- Mandatory own-field own-words title query (Gate 2 q5) -> Klein et al. 2022 "Toward Best Practices for Controlling Mammalian Cell Culture Environments"; opened; the nearest thing that exists, and it declines to ask the question of temperature.
- Method-owning field, standards vocabulary (Gate 2 q10) -> GCCP 2.0; opened; temperature is a monitor/calibrate/report item, no tissue-matching requirement.
- Gate 2 q12, "factorial culture temperature x oxygen tension interaction" -> recorded "NO temperature x oxygen factorial found". FALSIFIED at Gate 4 (see below).
- Cultivated-meat / livestock vocabulary (adversary 2 q5; adversary 3 q6; adversary 1 q1) -> Gregg et al. 2023 and Park et al. 2024, both opened; the two nearest priors, both missed by Gate 2, one of them surfaced at title level by Gate 2's own query 1 and left unopened.
- Answer-side limbs (four independent sweeps) -> no attribution estimate for temperature or oxygen anywhere.
- Genuine negatives reproduced independently: German-language critique literature (three adversaries, three phrasings) does not exist; MPS/organ-on-chip treats temperature as a controlled utility; hibernation/heterothermy and low-body-temperature mammals culture at 37 °C without raising the mismatch; no historical scholarship on why 37 °C was adopted.
COULD NOT READ (grounds no grade in either direction, recorded as Unverified, not as checks that passed): essay.utwente.nl/essays/85570, "The Influence of Hydrogel, Temperature, Oxygen, and Cytokines on Human Chondrocytes" — a temperature x oxygen study on a COOL tissue, JS-only repository record, PDF route untried (fetch cap); "Oxygenation in cell culture: Critical parameters for reproducibility are routinely not reported" — PMC-only routes in the result set, hard-blocked here; Cochrane CD012192 — the record states it was opened on cochranelibrary.com, adversary 1 got ROBOTS_DISALLOWED and adversary 2 HTTP 429 on doi.org, so it is not independently re-verified. GCCP 2.0's PDF truncated before section 3.2.1 "Culture conditions".

Novelty — nearest prior formulations (3, with sources):
PRIOR A (nearest in DESIGN; found only at Gate 4) — Park, Park, Oh, Lee & Choi (2024), "Developmental ability of Hanwoo muscle satellite cells under culture conditions mimicking the in vivo environment", Front Sustain Food Syst 8:1399801. Opened by adversary 2. Unit: Hanwoo muscle satellite cell cultures, one cell type, one species. Endpoint: proliferation and differentiation-marker performance. Comparator: 2x2, 37 vs 39 °C crossed with 20% vs 2% O2, justified by the animal's own in vivo values (core 38.5 °C; muscle O2 2.3-6.0%). Estimand: two-way ANOVA main effects plus interaction on performance; no in vivo reference profile, 38.5 °C never actually tested.
PRIOR B (nearest in FRAMING, same field's own words; surfaced at title level by Gate 2 q1 and left unopened) — Gregg, Hutson, Flees, Starkey & Starkey (2023), "Effect of standard and physiological cell culture temperatures on in vitro proliferation and differentiation of primary broiler chicken pectoralis major muscle satellite cells", Front Physiol 14:1288809. Opened by adversaries 1, 2 and 3. Unit: primary broiler PM satellite cells, n=18 donors. Endpoint: proliferation, fusion, apoptosis. Comparator: 38 °C "standard" vs 41 °C "physiological", the latter set from measured donor tissue temperature (41.14 +/- 0.08 °C). Estimand: condition differences; O2 fixed at 18% and never analysed; doubling time an outcome, not a matching variable. States the standard "may not be reproducing physiological conditions of the broiler SC niche in vivo".
PRIOR C (nearest formal posing of the setpoint question) — Cochrane Review protocol, "Temperature of embryo culture for assisted reproduction", doi 10.1002/14651858.CD012192. Unit: the woman randomised. Endpoint: live birth, miscarriage. Comparator: 37 °C vs any lower temperature (trials differing >= 0.5 °C). Estimand: Mantel-Haenszel odds ratio, ITT. NOT independently re-verified at Gate 4 (two routes blocked).
Background sources, evidence for the silence rather than priors (all opened): Klein et al. 2022, Front Cell Dev Biol 10:788808; Alva et al. 2022, Cells 11(19):3123; Metzger et al. 2022, Front Physiol 13:979283; Pamies et al. 2022, GCCP 2.0, ALTEX 39(1):30-70; van den Brink et al. 2017, Nat Methods 14:935-936. Per-attribute detail for each in the record.

Novelty — how this differs from each:
- vs PRIOR A: Park runs the candidate's crossing but not its estimand — performance endpoints, no in vivo reference and so no distance, no rate matching, no CIs on a fraction, one cell type, species-level body-temperature matching rather than tissue-level matching within a homeotherm, and no cooler-tissue case. The candidate is a generalisation plus a change of estimand, not a covariate or corpus swap on Park's question.
- vs PRIOR B: same framing ("standard" vs "physiological" setpoint, in vivo tissue temperature measured to set the arm) and it still produces no share, because it has no in vivo reference profile and no oxygen arm; its standard is 38 °C inherited from murine protocols, warm side only. It is the proof that the seam is non-trivial and that the question is asked locally without generalising.
- vs PRIOR C: the setpoint question is posed formally for one cell type, but the unit is the woman not the cell type, the endpoint is live birth not distance to an in vivo profile, the estimand is an odds ratio not a fraction of distance closed, and there is no oxygen arm and no interaction. The record's differentiator that the setpoint question is posed "only in clinical vocabulary" is RETIRED: PRIORS A and B pose it in cell-biology and animal-science vocabulary.

Novelty confidence: Medium — but on an INCOMPLETE search record, which is why this is not Validated. Two load-bearing Gate 2 negatives are falsified by papers opened at Gate 4 ("NO temperature x oxygen factorial found"; "the field runs factorials over media, O2, CO2 and pH - and not over temperature"), both in the one vocabulary Gate 2 itself flagged as swept only at title level. Medium survives because all three adversaries, across 27 new queries in 20+ vocabularies, found no source with the candidate's estimand, and four independent answer-side sweeps found no attribution estimate for temperature or oxygen; it is not High because two local posings of the setpoint question now exist, presupposition 2 is contraindicated rather than merely unmeasured, and the cool-tissue temperature x oxygen literature was not swept to the ground (the Twente chondrocyte thesis is unread).

Significance — consequence: If the temperature share is comparable to or larger than oxygen's, or the interaction is strong, culture temperature becomes a per-cell-type specification rather than an inherited constant — GCCP 2.0, PRINCE and repository datasheets would each have to carry a justified temperature, and the published phenotype of every cool- or warm-tissue cell type acquires a named, estimable bias term. If negligible, the inheritance is vindicated cheaply and the question retires, while the same experiment still yields the first attribution estimate for oxygen, which does not exist. A null is not a wasted experiment.

Significance — audience: (i) The cell-culture standards community (GCCP 2.0 authorship; ALTEX/3Rs), who currently file temperature under calibration; Klein's group already collects temperature-reporting statistics, so a justification requirement lands on an open file. (ii) The physioxia constituency (Stuart lab; Klein/Duarte), handed a second condition on their own scale. (iii) Organoid, MPS and organ-on-chip developers, who sell in vivo fidelity and already engineer non-default O2, pH and flow. (iv) Repositories (ATCC, ECACC), whose datasheets print 37 °C for essentially everything. (v) The communities already departing from the default without a shared frame — testis 32-34 °C, airway 33 °C, broiler 41 °C, Hanwoo 39 °C — two of which published setpoint-justification papers in 2023-2024.

Significance — fecundity: Opens a condition budget across temperature, O2, CO2/pH and media, of which the Klein/KAUST pH work and the 2025 physiological-media x oxygen factorials are the first cells. Makes askable: whether tissue-matched temperature moves IC50s and toxicology endpoints enough to matter for in vitro safety testing; whether existing per-tissue departures generalise or are local accidents; whether a thermal analogue of the HIF axis could give temperature a mechanistic constituency; and what counts as a reference profile when every candidate reference carries its own artefact.

Significance — anchoring: The in vitro/in vivo transcriptome gap and loss of tissue identity in culture; the supraphysiological-oxygen critique; cell-line drift and irreproducibility; the reporting-checklist movement (PRINCE, GCCP 2.0); and the open methodological problem of what a reference profile for a cell type is.

Reason for silence: Instrument history, framing capture, disciplinary boundary, plus a weak incentive limb. (1) Temperature was solved at the equipment level before it was ever posed as a biological specification question — verbatim-verified in Klein et al. 2022 by two adversaries ("thermal regimes of cell cultures may be reliably inferred from calibrated incubators"), and adversary 3's query 2 found no historical scholarship on the setpoint's origin at all; a parameter that looks already-reliable does not look askable. (2) Framing capture: non-37 °C was claimed by heat-shock and hypothermia biology as stress against a 37 °C zero point (GCCP 2.0's thresholds are stated in exactly those terms); corroborated in that Klein flags temperature as under-reported yet never asks whether the setpoint is right, and in that hibernation work reads non-37 °C as torpor modelling. Oxygen escaped this because HIF and ROS gave physioxia a mechanistic hook. (3) Disciplinary scatter: CONFIRMED, and this is now the best-evidenced limb — the setpoint question is being asked exactly where a boundary mechanism predicts (broiler-muscle physiology; cultivated-meat food systems; testis; skin; embryology in clinical vocabulary), each time justified ad hoc for one species and generalised to nothing, in venues the cell-culture standards literature does not read; the identical mis-specification argument is mature one level up in rodent-housing thermoneutrality and has not been carried down. What is silent is the AGGREGATION, not every instance — weaker than the record claimed, better evidenced. (4) The proliferation-rate confound is largely a why-answering-is-hard mechanism; two adversaries judged it the least evidenced limb. Three of four carry it.

Adversarial log (8 rows: attack | objection | response | status) — three independent fresh-context adversaries, each with 9 new Disguise-vocabulary queries (cap met, none refused), so Disguise was executed, not unverified; verbatim logs in batches/2026-10-17-2257/UQ-20261017-55-adversary-{1,2,3}.md. Status shown is the worst of the three.
1 | Triviality | Q10 effects and known heat-shock/cold-shock programmes settle it in a page; per-tissue practice already encodes the answer. | Direction is known, the share is not, and the sign is open: Gregg found in-vivo-matched 41 °C worsened fusion and raised apoptosis, Park found 39 °C inhibited proliferation while favouring differentiation, and a thermal effect orthogonal to the in vivo axis would close none of the distance. No attribution estimate exists for temperature or oxygen (four independent sweeps). | Resolved (3/3)
2 | Disguise | It is already asked in cellular-agriculture and poultry-science vocabulary: Park 2024 runs the exact 2x2 with an interaction term framed as "mimicking the in vivo environment"; Gregg 2023 is titled "standard and physiological cell culture temperatures". Two Gate 2 negatives are false and one stated differentiator is wrong. | Both opened and read in full; neither carries the estimand — no in vivo reference profile, no distance, no rate matching, no cooler-tissue limb, no common scale (Gregg has no oxygen arm). 27 new queries across 20+ vocabularies (toxicology/IVIVE, method history, ectotherm/poikilotherm, heterothermy, low-body-temperature mammals, German, airway, skin models, brown adipose/thermoneutrality, MPS, metascience, cartilage, dissociation artefact, four answer-side limbs) found no renamed version. A generalisation plus quantification of a locally asked question, not a disguised known. | Partial (A1 Resolved; A2, A3 Partial) — survives as a question; the Gate 2 search record is demonstrably incomplete.
3 | Combinatorial novelty | Thermal physiology x culture methodology, two knobs turned together, nothing at the seam. | Three seam-specific problems, each sourced: temperature changes proliferation rate so the main effect is confounded by construction (GCCP 2.0's own "growth below 35°C typically slows replication"); temperature shifts the CO2/bicarbonate pH equilibrium so the oxygen arm's gas phase is not independent of the temperature arm; the interaction is the interesting cell because HIF/ROS and thermal response share stress-pathway outputs, and Park's two factors push opposite ways on proliferation vs differentiation. Gregg is the proof: it ran the obvious contrast and still produced no share, for want of the reference. | Resolved (3/3)
4 | Presupposition failure | P2 (near-universal 37 °C) is contraindicated by the record's own most load-bearing source — Klein's "42% reported temperature and CO2 incubator settings" and "a number of studies used different culture temperatures" — and applied subfields have already moved off it. P4 (an in vivo reference) is unestablished, and van den Brink 2017 shows the reference-side artefact is an HSP/IEG signature on the same transcriptional axis as the warm arm, with fixes that are selections on a stress phenotype. | Both are flagged contested rather than smuggled, and P2 is made a measurable precondition ("must be measured before the factorial is worth running"); non-reporting is not deviation, and the same paper calls 37 °C the implicit assumption. V2's well-posedness does not need P2 to be universal — a tissue-matched vs 37 °C factorial is well-defined even if half of labs use 37 °C — so P2 is load-bearing for significance, not for well-posedness. The known exceptions are species-level matching in livestock, which leaves the cooler-tissue limb untouched. On P4, an operational reference exists (in-situ-vs-cultured comparisons are standard) and artefacts largely cancel in the temperature-vs-oxygen ratio; pre-declaring a metric that down-weights HSP/IEG transcripts is available but unevidenced. No adversary produced evidence that either presupposition is false. | Partial (3/3) — not Unresolved: the collinearity step is adversary 3's own labelled inference and unsourced, and the P2 objection is a dent in motivation, not a falsification.
5 | Vagueness | "Fraction of distance closed" is not metric-invariant; two defensible feature weightings on one dataset give materially different headline fractions, so the decision-relevant conclusion is reachable or avoidable by analysis choice. | Conceded in the record and the reason well-posedness is 2/3. Structural mitigation: temperature and oxygen shares come from the same experiment under the same declared metric, so the ratio that carries the argument is a within-dataset comparison in which the arbitrary choice appears in both terms, and pre-declaration forecloses answering to taste within a study. Not rescued: the absolute fraction is not poolable across studies, and no adversary would assert the ratio is metric-invariant without a source. | Partial (3/3)
6 | Significance inflation | The named audiences are decorative; standards bodies will not re-specify a parameter over one factorial, and Klein asks only that temperature be measured and reported. | Defeated by the same papers that damaged attack 2: two independent groups in 2023-2024 measured or cited their source organism's in vivo temperature, changed their setpoint on that basis and published it, i.e. an audience already acting on this question before the quantity exists. Klein's group collects temperature-reporting statistics; GCCP 2.0 carries the unelaborated hook "The optimal culture temperature depends on the type of cells involved". A null still produces the first oxygen attribution estimate. | Partial (A1, A2 Resolved; A3 Partial)

Three of four mechanisms hold, with the claim weakened from "nobody asks" to "nobody aggregates". | Partial (A1, A2 Resolved; A3 Partial)
8 | Dissolution | It dissolves into "which metric, which reference?": the in vitro-to-in vivo gap is dominated by dissociation artefact, dimensionality, serum and media, and asking for temperature's "fraction" presumes a decomposition that a non-additive interacting system does not admit — the demanded interaction term concedes the non-additivity. | V2 already asks for a per-cell-type vector with CIs plus the interaction rather than a universal scalar, which is the non-dissolving form, and the general claim tested is ordinal (is temperature's share comparable to oxygen's). But the headline framing does presuppose a decomposition the design may then show does not exist, presupposition 8 (media) is unchecked, and the temperature-dependent pH coupling means the "temperature" arm may be a bundle, so the estimand can erode. Nothing opened settles whether the fraction stays interpretable when the interaction is large. | Partial (3/3)
Unresolved: none, from any adversary. Unverified sub-items (recorded as unrun, never as passed and never as kills): the Twente chondrocyte temperature x oxygen thesis; the oxygen-reporting corpus survey (PMC hard-blocked); independent re-verification of PRIOR C, PRIOR 2 (Alva) and PRIOR 3 (Metzger). Declared budget overruns: Gate 2 12 searches against a cap of 11; adversary 3 five fetches against a cap of 4.

Scores: Well-posedness 2/3 · Significance 2/3

Strongest remaining objection: The headline estimand is not a property of nature, and the one principled repair makes it worse. "Fraction of distance closed" moves with the declared metric and feature weighting (conceded in the record, Partial for all three adversaries), and the in vivo reference it is measured against carries a documented heat-shock/immediate-early-gene artefact — van den Brink et al. 2017, opened: Fos induced during isolation, Hspa1b rising with collagenase exposure time, with the validated fixes being FACS selections on a stress phenotype. Hspa1b is heat-shock-inducible by definition, so the reference-side artefact sits on the same transcriptional axis as the candidate's warm arm; but pre-declaring a metric that excludes or down-weights HSP/IEG transcripts removes the transcripts most responsive to the treatment and biases temperature's share down on precisely the shared scale the question exists to create. Either way the number that would move a standards body is partly an artefact of the analyst's choice, and nothing any adversary opened evidences that the temperature-vs-oxygen ratio is stable across defensible metrics. (The collinearity step is adversary 3's own labelled inference, unsourced in the candidate's regime, which is why this is Partial and not a kill.)

Promotion requires: all four of — (1) re-run Gate 2's novelty grading with PRIORS A and B read — both now read at first hand, see the verification block — and the cool-tissue side swept to the ground, which still means opening the Twente chondrocyte thesis, "The Influence of Hydrogel, Temperature, Oxygen, and Cytokines on Human Chondrocytes using in vitro Culture-Based Models" (record 85570), and the bioprocess/CHO temperature-downshift and ectotherm literatures that remain title-level only, with the grade restated from papers in hand. Eight routes to the thesis have now failed and are not worth repeating: exact-title, keyword, extended and exact-phrase-plus-years searches (URL only, no snippet), purl.utwente.nl/essays/85570 (302 to the repository home page), essay.utwente.nl/essays/85570 and essay.utwente.nl/85570/ (JavaScript-only shells with no metadata), and core.ac.uk. What is left to try is a supervisor-group publication list, BASE, OpenAIRE, or asking the repository directly; (2) measure presupposition 2 against a protocol corpus, taking Klein's 42% temperature-reporting figure as the route and expecting a soft rather than universal default — if the corpus shows the default is not dominant, the significance case weakens rather than the question failing; (3) establish a defensible in vivo reference profile and a distance metric that survives the HSP/IEG dissociation artefact without excluding the transcripts the thermal arm acts on, with a stated argument for why the temperature-vs-oxygen ratio is robust to defensible metric choices — this is what would move well-posedness from 2/3 to 3/3; (4) read Cochrane CD012192 at full text rather than through a summariser — partly discharged: the completed review exists as CD012192.pub2, published 17 September 2019 and reporting results, with the 2016 protocol at the DOI this record cited, so PRIOR C is a completed review and not merely a protocol; it was read only in paraphrase, so its unit, endpoint and effect measure are not yet verbatim-verified. Nothing short of (1) and (3) can produce Validated: Gate 5 requires a complete search record and 3/3 well-posedness, and this entry currently has neither.

Suggested first step toward an answer (pointer only — do not take it): Do the corpus count before any wet work — text-mine methods sections for reported incubation temperature by tissue of origin, which settles presupposition 2 and tells you whether the question has a denominator at all; and in parallel read the unread cool-tissue temperature x oxygen work, because if it already carries an in vivo comparator the novelty grade changes before any factorial is designed.

Routing (if rejected as already-asked): Not applicable — not rejected, and not asked-but-open: the attribution estimand was found unposed by four independent answer-side sweeps, so there is no open-problem source to route.


Verification (post-batch, 33 fresh-context reads; full log in batches/2026-10-17-2257/VERIFICATION.md): Provisional STANDS. Three of the four promotion items moved, and none of the movement promotes the entry.
- PRIOR A (Park et al. 2024, Front Sustain Food Syst 8:1399801) confirmed at first hand and it does run the candidate's crossing: a genuine 2x2 of temperature (37 and 39 C) with oxygen (20% and 2%), with interaction terms reported. It does NOT reach the candidate's estimand: the endpoints are proliferation and differentiation markers only, there is no in vivo reference profile so no distance to in vivo can be computed, and the animal's stated in vivo 38.5 C was never tested as an arm. So the Gate 2 negative it falsifies is the one about the factorial existing, not the one about the estimand, and this entry's reading of it holds.
- PRIOR B (Gregg et al. 2023, Front Physiol 14:1288809) confirmed: the measured donor tissue temperature of 41.14 +/- 0.08 C is real, and the paper makes no comparison against an in vivo reference profile and computes no fraction of an in-vitro-to-in-vivo gap. Its framing is the candidate's; its estimand is not.
- PRIOR C is a COMPLETED REVIEW, not only a protocol: Cochrane CD012192.pub2, published 17 September 2019, reports results, with the 2016 protocol at the DOI this record cited. Read in paraphrase through a summariser only, so its unit, endpoint and effect measure are not verbatim-verified and promotion item (4) is only partly discharged.
- The Twente chondrocyte thesis remains COULD NOT READ after a second attempt, and its eight failed routes are now logged in the promotion clause so a later pass does not repeat them. Its title is established from search-index listings; author, year and programme are not. An unread document grounds no grade in either direction, so the cool-tissue side of Gate 2 is still open and promotion item (1) still stands.
- Nothing in this pass touched the entry's own strongest objection, which is that the headline estimand moves with the declared metric and that the in vivo reference carries a heat-shock artefact on the same transcriptional axis as the warm arm. That remains the reason well-posedness is 2/3.
